identity.title: Giratina and the Sky's Bouquet: Shaymin Music Collection

leadText: Giratina and the Sky's Bouquet: Shaymin Music Collection is a CD that was released in Japan on July 30, 2008.
plainText:
Giratina and the Sky's Bouquet: Shaymin Music Collection is a CD that was released in Japan on July 30, 2008.

==Tracklist==
Avant Medley 2008 (アバンメドレー2008)
Start of an Incident (事件のはじまり)
Title theme 2008 (タイトルテーマ2008)
Pancake (ホットケーキ)
Fight of Gods (神々の戦い)
Escape from the Reverse World (反転世界からの脱出)
army Invasion! (ジバコイル軍団襲来！)
Sky Forme (スカイフォルム)
Assault of the Army (急襲ジバコイル軍団)
Fly! (飛べ！シェイミ)
VS (シェイミVSギラティナ)
Zero traps (ゼロの罠)
Capture (ギラティナ捕獲)
A great air war! (大空中戦！)
(アロマセラピー)
Mechanic Giratina's motion (メカギラティナ発動)
Satoshi's appearance! (サトシ登場！)
and (レジギガスとマンムー)
Satoshi's end of life (サトシ絶対絶命)
The last (最後のシードフレア)
Conclusion (大団円)
The Sky's Bouquet (Sky's Bouquet) (氷空の花束（そらのはなたば）)
(Music Box version) (ONE（オルゴール・バージョン）)
Stay with This Finger (Movie Version) (このゆびとまれ（映画バージョン）)
